findings.issue: Module is clean, concise, and correct. fitz.open failures are caught and re-raised as UnreadablePDFError. doc.close() is always called via try/finally. DPI matrix is correct (150/72). Page numbers are 1-based. JPEG encoding via pix.tobytes('jpeg') is correct.
Module-level constant for the DPI matrix is a good pattern — avoids recreating it for every page.
